# GaleOps

> GaleOps builds custom AI agents that run your business's busywork. Automation Sprints to build agents, Managed AI to keep them running, and AI Safety Checks — built safe from day one. Led by Mathew Gale.

## Core Services

### Managed AI — Run Your AI Agent Fleet
- Fractional service that keeps your AI agents running: cost governance (FinOps for AI agents), reliability and observability, and incident response.
- $500-$2,500/mo retainers · $500 Automation Sprint to build your first agent.
- URL: https://galeops.xyz/agentic-ops

### Agent Memory Layer — Persistent, Private AI Memory
- Persistent, private, searchable operating context for AI agents, with scoped memory, source provenance, explicit promotion, and safe idempotent refreshes.
- Memory Readiness Audit: $1,500 one-time · Memory Foundation: $4,500+ implementation · Managed MemoryOps: $1,500+/month.
- URL: https://galeops.xyz/agent-memory/
- Interactive walkthrough: https://galeops.xyz/demo/agent-memory/

### Founding AI Agent Risk Review — $750
- Focused review of one deployed customer-facing AI agent with real data access or tool permissions.
- Includes attack-surface mapping, targeted prompt-injection and unsafe-action testing, three prioritised attack paths, written remediation guidance, and a 30-minute debrief.
- Delivered within 5 business days after agreed scope and test access.
- The $750 fee is credited toward a full AI Security Audit.
- URL: https://galeops.xyz/ai-security#risk-review

### AI Security Audit — $6,000
- Comprehensive adversarial assessment of deployed LLMs and AI agents.
- Covers prompt injection, retrieved-content attacks, data exposure, and unsafe tool access.
- URL: https://galeops.xyz/ai-security

### AI Guardrail Setup — $8,000
- Implementation of scoped guardrails, policy enforcement, monitoring, and engineering documentation after verified findings.
- URL: https://galeops.xyz/ai-security

### AI Red Team & Compliance — $12,000
- Expanded adversarial assessment plus EU AI Act and NIST AI RMF alignment for complex systems.
- URL: https://galeops.xyz/ai-security
